decisions.rationale: The actual controller records the real workspace RESULT.json path; requiring renamed copies inside the limitation subtree makes genuine status/result evidence impossible while fabricated replacements remain possible. Keeping only limitation-owned adapters confined and hash-referencing the real safe artifacts preserves validation and restores deployability.
decisions.smallest_fix: Permit exact hash-bound real controller status and workspace RESULT.json references, require status.result_validation to match them, and keep only assignment/diagnostic/launch/execution adapters at exact attempt-confined paths.

decisions.rationale: Mutually comparing free adapter identities does not bind them to the actual controller. Deriving one canonical PID-plus-creation identity from the validated terminal status and requiring all adapters to equal it is a minimal ownership fix using already-required fields.
decisions.smallest_fix: Return a closed controller identity derived from controller_pid and controller_created_utc (or the recorded started fallback) in the actual status, and require assignment, launch, execution, and diagnostic controller identities to equal it exactly.
